tools.name: get_vehicle_state
tools.description: Read the full simulated vehicle state before answering status questions or deciding follow-up vehicle actions.

tools.name: get_climate_status
tools.description: Read climate, airflow, defrost, seat comfort, steering-wheel heating, and cabin/outside temperatures.

tools.name: get_window_status
tools.description: Read side windows, sunroof, sunshade, and defrost status.

tools.name: get_light_status
tools.description: Read low/high/fog lights, reading lights, and ambient light status.

tools.name: get_driver_context
tools.description: Read Gear, speed, drive time, DMS, seatbelt, occupancy, battery/range, charging, and current location.

tools.name: set_gear_position
tools.description: Set mocked vehicle gear position for simulator safety policy: P, R, N, or D.

tools.name: set_hvac_power
tools.description: Turn the cabin climate system on or off.

value.description: true turns HVAC on, false turns HVAC off.

tools.name: set_hvac_temperature
tools.description: Set the driver or passenger climate target temperature in Celsius.

tools.name: set_hvac_rear_temperature
tools.description: Set the rear/third HVAC zone target temperature in Celsius for VF9 3-zone climate.

tools.name: set_hvac_ionizer
tools.description: Turn the VF9 cabin air ionizer on or off.

tools.name: set_drive_mode
tools.description: Set VF9 drive mode while safely parked: Eco, Normal, or Sport. Assistant use requires confirmation.

tools.name: set_regen_brake
tools.description: Set VF9 regenerative braking while safely parked: Off, Low, Medium, or High. Assistant use requires confirmation.

tools.name: set_charge_limit
tools.description: Set VF9 charge limit percentage from 50 to 100.

tools.name: set_charge_port
tools.description: Open or close the VF9 charging flap simulation — the small cover over the charging socket. NOT a passenger door (set_door_lock) and not the boot (set_tailgate_position).

tools.name: set_special_mode
tools.description: Turn a VF9 special mode on or off: camp, pet, valet, nap, or zen.

tools.name: set_bluetooth
tools.description: Turn the VF9 in-car Bluetooth on or off.

tools.name: set_wifi
tools.description: Turn the VF9 in-car Wi-Fi on or off.

tools.name: set_esim
tools.description: Turn the VF9 in-car eSIM data connection on or off.

tools.name: set_active_user_profile
tools.description: Switch the active VF9 driver user profile by name.

tools.name: set_seat_ventilation_row2
tools.description: Set VF9 row-2 seat ventilation level from 0 to 3.

tools.name: set_seat_memory
tools.description: Recall a saved VF9 seat memory preset (1-3) for driver or passenger.

tools.name: set_fan_speed
tools.description: Set HVAC fan speed from 0 to 7.

tools.name: set_airflow_mode
tools.description: Set cabin airflow mode.

mode.description: Airflow target: auto, face, feet, or defrost.

tools.name: set_air_recirculation
tools.description: Turn cabin air recirculation on or off.

value.description: true uses recirculated air, false uses outside air.

tools.name: set_window_defrost
tools.description: Turn VF9 defrost/defog on or off. VF9 baseline supports heated rear glass; front windshield heating is unsupported, but airflow defrost can still be used.

target.description: Defrost target: front windshield, rear window, or all.

value.description: true turns defrost on, false turns defrost off.

tools.name: set_window_position
tools.description: Set a window opening percentage. 0 means closed, 100 means fully open.

tools.name: set_all_windows
tools.description: Set all side windows to the same opening percentage.

percentage.description: Window opening percentage for all windows.

tools.name: set_sunroof_position
tools.description: Set panoramic sunroof opening percentage. VF9 baseline does not support sunroof; this only works if a future/optional profile enables it.

tools.name: set_sunshade_position
tools.description: Set panoramic roof sunshade/cover opening percentage. VF9 baseline does not support roof shade; this only works if a future/optional profile enables it.

tools.name: set_door_lock
tools.description: Lock or unlock passenger-door locks only. Use this tool only when the user explicitly asks to lock or unlock a door. Never use it for a request to open or close a physical passenger door; those doors are not motorised or controllable by this assistant. Not the rear boot lid and not the charging flap.

locked.description: true locks the door, false unlocks it.

tools.name: set_tailgate_position
tools.description: Open or close the powered tailgate — the boot lid at the rear of the car. Use only for an explicit tailgate, boot or cargo-door request. Never use it for a generic request to open or close passenger doors.

tools.name: set_mirror_fold
tools.description: Fold or unfold outside rear-view mirrors.

folded.description: true folds mirrors, false unfolds mirrors.

tools.name: set_headlight
tools.description: Turn headlights on or off.

value.description: true turns headlights on, false turns headlights off.

tools.name: set_headlight_mode
tools.description: Set headlight mode: off, low beam/cốt, or high beam/pha. Prefer this over set_headlight when the user mentions pha or cốt.

tools.name: set_fog_light
tools.description: Turn front fog lights on or off. VF9 baseline does not support front fog lights.

value.description: true turns fog lights on, false turns them off.

tools.name: set_reading_light
tools.description: Turn cabin reading light on or off for driver, passenger, rear seats, or all.

value.description: true turns reading light on, false turns it off.

tools.name: set_ambient_light
tools.description: Turn the cabin ambient light on or off, or set its brightness. The light has a single fixed warm colour that cannot be changed.

enabled.description: true turns ambient light on, false turns it off.

tools.name: set_adas_feature
tools.description: Change an ADAS setting subject to runtime authorization. Warning-only features may be enabled by the assistant; disabling warnings or changing intervention settings requires parked confirmation. Adaptive cruise/highway assist engagement uses steering-wheel controls, and core safety features cannot be disabled by the assistant.

value.description: true turns the ADAS feature on, false turns it off.

tools.name: set_wiper
tools.description: Set windshield wiper level (0=off, 1=intermittent, 2=low, 3=high) or turn auto wipers on/off.

tools.name: set_current_location
tools.description: Set the mocked current GPS/location of the vehicle for navigation simulation.

origin.description: Current location, address, place name, or lat/lng.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for anything the car cannot know by itself. Two kinds of use: (a) FACTS about the outside world, especially ones that change over time -- weather and forecasts, traffic, opening hours, prices, news; (b) CONTENT the driver asks to be told or read out -- a story, a joke, a poem, song lyrics, a recipe, a riddle, an explanation. A request to be TOLD something is a search, not a refusal: search first, then narrate what you found in your own words. Never answer from memory and call it a search, and never offer to play a video or music instead unless the driver asked for video or music. DO NOT use it for anything about THIS car -- battery, range, cabin or outside temperature, windows, lights, doors, drive mode, charge level, or the current time and date. All of that is already in the vehicle state, where it is exact and free; searching for it would be slower and less accurate.

query.description: What to search for, phrased as a search query.

maxResults.description: How many results to fetch. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: lookup_place_info
tools.description: Look up background information about a place, landmark, building, or point of interest when the user asks what/where it is or wants to know about it. Does not start navigation.

place.description: Name of the place, landmark, or point of interest to look up.

tools.name: open_google_maps_route
tools.description: Open Google Maps navigation to a destination. Use for route, directions, POI, restaurant, charging station, or nearby place requests.

origin.description: Current vehicle location, GPS text, address, or lat/lng used as route origin.

destination.description: Destination, POI, address, or nearby search query.

routeMode.description: Route mode: driving, avoid_tolls, or charging.

tools.name: stop_navigation
tools.description: Stop active navigation and clear the current destination.

tools.name: get_navigation_eta
tools.description: Read active navigation ETA, distance, origin, destination, and route mode.

tools.name: play_youtube_media
tools.description: Play music, a podcast, a video, or a playlist for an entertainment request, from any music service the user names. Also stops or pauses playback with playing=false.

query.description: YouTube search query, song, artist, playlist, or video. Required to start playback; omit it to stop or pause whatever is currently playing.

playing.description: true starts playback, false pauses/stops playback.

tools.name: set_media_volume
tools.description: Set media volume from 0 to 100 percent.

tools.name: set_media_mute
tools.description: Mute or unmute current media audio.

tools.name: skip_youtube_media
tools.description: Skip current YouTube mock media to next or previous item.

tools.name: set_seat_ventilation
tools.description: Set seat ventilation level from 0 to 3.

tools.name: set_seat_massage
tools.description: Set seat massage mode.

tools.name: set_seat_heating
tools.description: Set seat heating level from 0 to 3. VF9 baseline does not support seat heating.

tools.name: set_steering_wheel_heating
tools.description: Set steering wheel heating level from 0 to 3. VF9 baseline does not support steering wheel heating.

tools.name: set_vehicle_context
tools.description: Mock read-only vehicle context for testing: speed, drive time, DMS, seatbelt, occupancy, battery, charging, and temperatures.
